definition: Core GP>=10, MPG>=15, continuous MPG weights; eligible single-team core throughout season. Multi-team players limited to observed first/last in-team dates to reduce trade-as-absence confounding. Actual active roster determines absence, not realized game minutes. Player and game IDs used only diagnostic joins. Team + opponent fixed effects, common home and linear time adjustment; two team rows clustered by fixture. Coefficients describe error association, not causal injury effects. Full-season MPG is diagnostic weighting only and never input to future engine. Positive offense error slope means simulated offense falls too little with own absence; negative allowed-error slope means defense worsens too little.
